engines.name: Corrected Band Engine
engines.kill_criterion: the 68 percent band's coverage at any horizon sits outside its binomial interval after 120 graded forecasts, or a plain HAR band beats it on pinball at equal width.
engines.proving_threshold: 120 live forecasts (68% band claim graded at 120)

calibration_attestation.basis: 2 graded forecasts of 30 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: crps_approx 2.4433, pinball@0.025 0.4241, pinball@0.095 1.2854, pinball@0.16 1.8976, pinball@0.25 2.5425, pinball@0.75 2.2725, pinball@0.84 1.1256, pinball@0.905 0.1314, pinball@0.975 0.0941); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

engines.notes: FE12 session quality guard (DEEP-PASS 3.2 item 10): one sided liquidity deterioration flag in site/engine_adaptations.py, consumed in refresh_correctedband.py as a band widener (bands_for guard factor) and abstention raiser; his intercept and weights were not imported. The corrected band routes are daily bars only, so no intraday spread, depth, volume concentration or intraday realised vol reading is on record and the guard publishes not_recorded, widening nothing. FE08 HAR control (3.2 item 14): this engine is graded against the fixed weight HAR control on QLIKE in forecast/grading.py har_control_report, beside its pinball and coverage grades.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: sellers of index volatility and users of the vendor expected move band, whose uncorrected band misprices the move this engine sizes.
edge_card.bad_state: A vol regime break (VIX backwardation beyond the registered widening, or a realised vol jump the HAR spine cannot follow) makes every band too narrow at once.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Bands are holdable as a sizing input at 1, 5 and 21 sessions with no carry cost of their own; when bands fail they fail together across SPY and QQQ, so co losses are index wide, not name specific.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Any strategy sizing off these bands pays its own spread and slippage outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The vendor expected move band and a plain HAR band at equal width, graded on pinball loss and coverage per band per horizon.

engines.name: Touch Surface
engines.kill_criterion: after 100 sessions per index cell, it does not beat the dead model's Brier score, or its reliability error exceeds 10 points.

calibration_attestation.basis: 18 graded forecasts of 108 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: brier 0.2252, log_loss 0.6317); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: buyers of touch and barrier style payoffs priced off the vendor reflection formula, which overstates touch odds by a measured 13 to 30 points.
edge_card.bad_state: A one way trend day or an overnight gap jumps clean over a level, so daily high and low bars record a touch that intraday holders could not act on, and quiet regimes make every cell stale at once.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Probabilities are holdable as inputs across 1, 5 and 21 sessions; the plus and minus cells for one name are mechanically linked, so a grading miss on one side raises the chance of a miss on the other.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Acting on a touch probability pays the underlying spread and any option spread outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The driftless barrier estimate and the vendor reflection formula 2N(.) with its measured overstatement haircut, per distance and horizon cell.

engines.name: Own-Norm Depth Forecaster
engines.kill_criterion: after 200 matured forecasts, the quintile spread's confidence interval includes zero.

calibration_attestation.basis: no graded forecasts on record yet (0 recorded, 0 graded); nothing has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: dip buyers who buy every pullback at the index norm rather than the name's own norm, and momentum holders who exit shallow pullbacks in strong names.
edge_card.bad_state: A name whose character changes (a broken business, a regime shift in its own volatility) makes its trailing 750 session depth distribution the wrong norm, so depth percentiles stop meaning what they meant.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: The 20 session horizon is holdable for a paper position; pullback cohorts cluster by market stress, so many names enter together and their outcomes are correlated, not independent.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: the grade is on excess return against SPY before costs. A paper position realising it would pay spread and slippage outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The same name's unconditional 20 session excess return rate and the index norm pullback rule, at the same depth percentiles.

grading_convention.issued_value_scale: probability p that the 20 session excess return against SPY is positive, plus a median excess estimate in points
grading_convention.realised_scale: fraction excess against SPY with its sign as the binary outcome: the shared resolver kind excess_sign
grading_convention.note: The registered grading rule is the probability score, so the realised value the grade needs is the sign of the excess, which the old own return fraction resolver could not produce. No live rows stood on the ledger at the effective date (the live branch was blocked on the missing session calendar, cured the same day in forecast/session_calendar.py); new live rows carry kind excess_sign with benchmark SPY.

engines.name: Stress-Reversal Staging
engines.kill_criterion: stage 1 fails its pre-registered bar in the first 3 forward episodes, and the script retires as a whole.

calibration_attestation.basis: 1209 graded forecasts of 1815 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: brier@1 0.2544, brier@3 0.4147); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

inputs.name: SPY drawdown tercile from SPY history

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: forced and panicked sellers in the deepest SPY drawdown tercile, whose indiscriminate selling overshoots the loser cohort's peer gap.
edge_card.bad_state: A drawdown that keeps deepening (the reversal script's stage one simply never fires) or a cohort whose losers are losers for permanent reasons, so the peer gap is information, not overshoot.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Staged at plus 1, plus 3 and plus 5 sessions, so each stage is separately holdable and separately falsifiable; the whole cohort shares one market condition, so stage failures arrive together.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: grades are on cohort returns before costs. Entering a stressed cohort pays wide spreads and gap risk outside this record, which is why staging, not sizing, is the claim.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The unstaged T2 reversal effect on the same cohort and condition, and the cohort's own unconditional return after deep drawdown days.

engines.notes: Options candidate gate (DEEP-PASS 3.1 item 3, 2026-10-29): Greeks older than 75 minutes or future dated refuse where a Greek timestamp exists, undated labelling where none does, IV ceiling 500 percent; shared module site/options_gate.py.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: options buyers and sellers pricing finish above strike odds off the raw chain, including strikes whose quotes are stale, undated or too wide to be a real price.
edge_card.bad_state: An expiry week with a macro print or a pin that drags the final close, where the whole surface is wrong in the same direction at once; contracts failing the Greek freshness gate leave holes in the surface rather than graded claims.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Each day's surface is ledgered separately to expiry, so it is holdable as a record; strikes on one expiry share one final close, so their grades are one event, not independent trials.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: POP is graded against the final close, not against a fill. Trading a strike pays its spread, which on the gated out contracts is exactly why they were gated out.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The chain's own implied finish above probability read straight off prices, per strike, with no calibration correction.

inputs.name: DEEP daily bars and trade counts

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: buyers of tail protection and sellers of the priced expected move, whoever is mispricing how often the absolute move beats 1 and 2 EM.
edge_card.bad_state: A vol compression regime where exceedances cluster into a few weeks and vanish for months, so the graded sample is a handful of shared events wearing many tickers.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Probabilities cover 5 session and 21 session windows and are holdable as risk inputs; exceedances across SPY, QQQ and IWM on the same shock are the same event, so co losses are systemic.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Tail trades that use it pay option spreads and theta outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The priced expected move itself: the exceedance rate implied by 1 and 2 EM under a normal move distribution, and the name's own trailing exceedance rate.

engines.name: Realised-Vol Term Shape Forecaster
engines.kill_criterion: after 52 weekly cohorts, quantile coverage misses its stated rates by more than 10 points at two or more horizons.

calibration_attestation.basis: no graded forecasts on record yet (24 recorded, 0 graded); nothing has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

inputs.name: HAR components from index daily bars

engines.notes: FE08 HAR control (DEEP-PASS 3.2 item 14): this engine is graded against the fixed weight HAR control (0.50 log rv 1, 0.30 log rv 5, 0.20 log rv 22) on QLIKE in forecast/grading.py har_control_report; the engine variance equivalent is its median realised vol quantile squared, stated in the grading module.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: vol traders pricing one horizon off another (calendar and term structure positioning) when the realised term shape is about to differ from the implied one.
edge_card.bad_state: A single shock week dominates all three horizons at once, flattening the shape the engine claims to separate, and 63 session windows overlap so heavily that graded samples are far fewer than they look.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Weekly issuance with 5, 21 and 63 session horizons is holdable as a vol input; the three horizon grades from one issuance share the same realised path and cannot be counted as independent.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Realising a term shape view pays vol product spreads and roll outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The implied vol term shape read off the chain and the flat forecast that future realised vol equals its trailing level at every horizon.

engines.name: Wall Lifetime and Break Forecaster
engines.kill_criterion: after 60 cards per index, its 5-session touch calibration error exceeds 10 points or its break Brier is no better than the unconditional break rate.

calibration_attestation.basis: 36 graded forecasts of 189 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: brier 0.1029, log_loss 0.3038, ranked_probability_score 2.3842); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: traders who treat a published wall or flip level as durable support or resistance for its whole life, including after the inventory that built it has moved.
edge_card.bad_state: A fast repricing day where walls are run through in sequence, or a map built on a stale chain, makes lifetimes collapse together across SPY, QQQ and IWM.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Levels are graded at 1, 3, 5 and 10 sessions, so a level view is holdable only inside its stated window; call wall, put wall and flip grades for one map share one price path.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Trading into a wall pays the spread and risks the break itself, outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The naive durability assumption that a wall survives its window, and a distance only model that prices break odds from how far spot sits from the level with no lifetime record.

engines.name: Intake-Bias Reversal
engines.kill_criterion: after 80 fires, the interaction mean is zero or positive, or no better than short volume alone. This is a cohort fade forecast, never a short book: A16 killed shorting picked names after borrow costs.

calibration_attestation.basis: no graded forecasts on record yet (10 recorded, 0 graded); nothing has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

engines.notes: FE02 Hurst gate (DEEP-PASS 3.2 item 15): admitted as a conditioner candidate only, recorded in registry research_questions (fe02_hurst_gate); not wired, because no Hurst estimator exists in our stack, and this engine's scores do not change until one is built and frozen.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: buyers chasing a vendor flow score whose bullishness is manufactured by buys only intake, paying up for flow that the all prints record does not confirm.
edge_card.bad_state: A tape regime where short volume data lags or the intake gap is wide for mechanical reasons (a print classification change), so the manufactured bullishness reading is an artifact of the feed, not of positioning.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: The claim is a cohort mean over 5 sessions and is holdable only as a cohort, never as a single name call; cohort members share the flow regime that selected them, so outcomes correlate.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: the grade is the cohort's mean excess return before costs. Fading a crowded flow cohort pays borrow and spread outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The buys only Algo Score taken at face value on the same cohort, and the all prints score with no short volume condition.

engines.kill_criterion: after 60 fires per arm, either arm's mean sign is wrong.

engines.notes: FE23 plan adjusted insider flow (DEEP-PASS 3.2 item 7): Form 4 footnote plan status classifier in site/engine_adaptations.py, precision tracked against a labelled set under a registered kill floor of 0.90 on at least 20 labelled footnotes. The insider record is summary grain with no footnotes, so no name is classified and no leg is adjusted today; state published in the page's plan_adjustment block.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: whichever of the two best informed families is wrong at a divergence: insider sellers who know less than the options flow, or options buyers positioned against what insiders are doing.
edge_card.bad_state: Divergences driven by hedging rather than information (insider sales under plans, options flow that is a hedge leg) make the disagreement meaningless, and heavy net selling clusters in falling names whose underperformance is momentum, not information.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: The 21 session horizon is holdable for a paper position; divergence names cluster by sector and event calendar, so the cohort's outcomes are not independent draws.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: the grade is mean excess return against SPY before costs. Acting on it pays spread and, on the short side, borrow, outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: Each family alone on the same names: insider net selling by itself and top bucket options Heat by itself, over the same 21 sessions.

engines.name: Gamma-Pressure Earnings Trap
engines.kill_criterion: after 60 events, the exceedance confidence interval includes 50 percent or the median ratio is below 1.0.

inputs.name: earnings calendar with priced expected move

engines.notes: Options candidate gate (DEEP-PASS 3.1 item 3, 2026-10-29): Greeks older than 75 minutes or future dated refuse where a Greek timestamp exists, undated labelling where none does, IV ceiling 500 percent; shared module site/options_gate.py.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: sellers of earnings premium who price the expected move off the chain while dealer gamma is positioned to amplify whichever way the print jumps.
edge_card.bad_state: Negative index GEX that flips before the report, or an earnings move driven by guidance in the call rather than the print, so the amplification the trap counts on is absent or mistimed; direction is never claimed, so a huge move the wrong way still pays the claim and that asymmetry is the claim.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Names reporting inside 5 sessions under one index GEX reading share that reading, so a wrong regime call fails the whole season's cohort together.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: the grade compares realised to chain priced move before costs. Harvesting it with options pays the earnings spread and crush, outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The chain priced expected move itself (realised equals priced, ratio 1.0) and the same test run without the negative GEX condition.

engines.name: Earnings Move Distribution Engine
engines.kill_criterion: after two full seasons, the 80 percent band's coverage sits outside 70 to 90 percent, or exceedance Brier is no better than quoting the priced move's implied rate.

calibration_attestation.basis: 8 graded forecasts of 290 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: coverage_hit 0.0000, crps_approx 2.1797, pinball@0.1 0.3293, pinball@0.2 0.7429, pinball@0.3 0.9610, pinball@0.4 1.2495, pinball@0.5 1.4050, pinball@0.6 1.5215, pinball@0.7 1.4588, pinball@0.8 1.2411, pinball@0.9 0.8996); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

engines.notes: FE17 blend registered as this engine's centre (takes over the middle step per name when its implied move, dispersion and timing inputs exist; the priced move and timing inputs landed 2026-10-30, and the dispersion input is the forecast error dispersion on record under the amendment in this entry's fe17_centre block, so the centre is recorded per name where all inputs exist). FE18 ledgered as a sub forecast under its own quantity, issued only after the 5 session drift window it consumes closes and graded over the next 5 sessions; standardized surprise and revision breadth have no source on disk (open remainder, DEEP-PASS 3.2 item 6). FE04 fair gap residual conditioner for Engine 28 waits on a fair gap model neither side has (open).

fe17_centre.blend: centre = (0.60 * implied move + 0.40 * historical event move) * (1 + 0.08 * clip(dispersion_z, -2, 2)) * timing_quality

inputs.name: implied_move
inputs.definition: the name's chain priced expected move, from the per name priced move record

inputs.name: historical_event_move
inputs.definition: the typical (middle) past move of the name's own historical earnings move distribution
inputs.source: this engine's distribution, built from the DEEP report-day history

inputs.name: dispersion
inputs.definition: forecast error dispersion: the standard deviation of the name's own prior forecast errors, z scored across reporting names. Not cross analyst estimate dispersion.

inputs.name: timing_quality
inputs.definition: report timing quality from the earnings record lane's report time classes

amendment.authority: the owner's decision on the terminal ruling items, delegated to Midna on 2026-10-30 (leave it to Midna as long as it works as intended)
amendment.change: the centre's registered dispersion input is defined as the forecast error dispersion on record, under its own true name and definition
amendment.reason: the originally registered input, cross analyst estimate dispersion, is carried by no free source, because no free source carries individual analyst estimates, so the centre could never take over; the forecast error dispersion the earnings record carries is a different quantity, and it is adopted as itself. It is never renamed into analyst estimate dispersion, and the lane's refusal to rename it stands as correct.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: the options market pricing an earnings move distribution that is systematically narrower or wider than the distribution that actually arrives, season after season.
edge_card.bad_state: A season where macro news swamps every print, so all names move together and the per name distributions grade as one event; a thin calendar season also leaves too few reports to grade the season as a season.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: Each report is graded on its earnings day move and its signed 5 session drift; names reporting the same day share the market leg of both windows.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Trading an earnings distribution pays the widest spreads of the year, outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The chain priced expected move as a one number distribution, and the name's own historical earnings move distribution with no chain input.

engines.name: Idiosyncratic-or-Liquidity Splitter
engines.kill_criterion: a leg is retired independently if its median confidence interval includes zero after 150 episodes.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: sellers (and buyers) who treat every sharp decline the same: panic sellers of liquidity driven drops that reverse, and dip buyers of idiosyncratic drops that persist.
edge_card.bad_state: A market wide break where the SPY flat condition misclassifies (the market falls the next day instead), or idiosyncratic news that is fully resolved in a day, so persistence and reversal swap sides.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: The 20 session excess horizon is holdable for a paper position; liquidity driven cases arrive in market clusters, so that arm's outcomes are one regime bet, not many.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: grades are excess returns before costs. Buying a falling name pays spread and gap through risk outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The undifferentiated rule that every drop of 2 own residual vol units behaves the same, and a market only split with no own norm sizing.

grading_convention.issued_value_scale: point estimate in points of 20 session excess return against SPY
grading_convention.realised_scale: points: the shared resolver kind excess_return_points returns (own return minus SPY return) times 100
grading_convention.note: Before this convention the outcome spec carried only the name's own return as a fraction, so the point estimate in points of excess had no matching realised value. Issued rows are not edited; the legacy map resolves their excess against SPY, the benchmark their issuing record names. New rows carry kind excess_return_points with benchmark SPY. No ungraded present rows of this kind stood on the ledger at the effective date; the convention binds the next issuance.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: anyone pricing a spiked name's future vol off a market wide clock (a fixed number of sessions) instead of the name's own history of coming home.
edge_card.bad_state: A spike that is a regime change rather than an episode: vol steps up and stays, the clock runs past its band, and every name spiked by the same shock shares the failure.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: A timing distribution, holdable as an expectation, not a date; names spiked by one market event have synchronised clocks, so their grades correlate.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: no execution cost is charged to the grade. Short vol harvested against the clock pays margin and gap risk outside this record.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The market wide median normalisation time applied to every name, and the name's own unconditional median time above its median vol.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: cross sectional models that price a name off other names like it, when the name's own past in the same state carries the better distribution.
edge_card.bad_state: A name whose own history is short, reconstituted or regime broken, so its nearest past states are few or belong to a different company in effect; analogue windows overlap, shrinking the honest sample.
edge_card.holdability_and_co_losses: The plus 21 session distribution is holdable for a paper position; analogue sets drawn from one era share that era's market path in the grading window.
edge_card.execution_net: A forecast, not a trade: the grade is coverage of the realised return inside the published band, before costs.
edge_card.price_aware_baseline: The cross sectional peer distribution for the same state, and the name's own unconditional plus 21 session return distribution.

grading_convention.issued_value_scale: quantiles in percent (own 21 session return, percent)
grading_convention.realised_scale: percent: the shared resolver kind return_percent returns the own return times 100
grading_convention.note: Before this convention the shared resolver returned a fraction for kind return, so a percent quantile would have been graded against a fraction (a factor of 100 too small) at the first maturities from 2026-11-26. Issued rows are not edited; grade_forecast rewrites a copy of their outcome spec through this legacy map. New rows are issued with kind return_percent.

edge_card.payer: Hypothesized payer: late sellers capitulating at the volume climax and momentum shorts pressing a beaten down name exactly when its own down volume says exhaustion.
edge_card.bad_state: Capitulation that is the start of a collapse rather than its end (fraud, solvency), where the volume climax repeats; the 95th percentile trigger also fires rarely, so the record accrues slowly and clusters in crashes.

Estimation record: gap-destiny/news_leg_estimation.json.

registry_notes: Kill criteria transcribed from each engine's Grading protocol in FORECAST-ENGINES-30.md. Proving thresholds are the forecast/event counts named in those same protocols as the kill-decision sample sizes; where the design names the threshold only inside the kill sentence, it is recorded here from that sentence and the kill_criterion field carries the full text. Input lists are transcribed from each engine's Data route and Mechanism; each input is assigned to exactly one family per N3. Ambiguity: the design does not publish a separate per-engine input inventory, so inputs are the load-bearing inputs named in the design text, no more.

route_evidence.missing: analyst level arrival times (no source carries them) and any vintage depth before 2026-10-30: a backfilled estimates database stays disqualified by the decision rule, so the route exists only forward from its first snapshot

wired.state: wired_accrual: the vintage route exists only forward from its first snapshot; nothing before 2026-10-30 can be added without backfill, which the decision rule disqualifies

research_questions.name: Cross-asset lead-lag graph
research_questions.statement: Does a leader move forecast a follower name through a single estimated edge (lag beta times stability times an R2 soft threshold that zeroes weak edges)?

data_routes.name: cross-asset daily and intraday bars (indices, sectors, futures proxies)
pair selection, beta, stability and R2 estimation with clock alignment

research_questions.decision_rule: Promote only when the edge estimation (pair selection, beta, stability, R2, clock alignment) is built and frozen per pair in advance; the source package contains none of it, so the formula alone is not adoptable.

estimation_frozen.form: edge = lag_beta * stability * clip((r2 - 0.005) / (0.03 - 0.005), 0, 1), lag one shared session, trailing 500 aligned sessions, minimum 250
estimation_frozen.wiring_state: not wired: the estimation the decision rule requires is built and frozen per pair in the run record; no engine consumes an edge yet, and no engine score changes because of this entry

research_questions.name: Hurst chop gate (conditioner only)
research_questions.statement: FE02 is admitted only as a conditioner: its Hurst chop gate, clip((0.58 - hurst) / 0.25, 0, 1), may shrink reversion scores toward zero in choppy regimes on the named engines. Its headline residual fade score is not adopted, because the code read showed the gate contributes more than the headline term, and neither the Hurst estimator nor the residual model exists in the source package or in our stack.

data_routes.name: daily bars on the DEEP panel (the gate's only raw input once a Hurst estimator is built)
Hurst estimator, frozen window and method

estimator_frozen.method: detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) on log returns
estimator_frozen.measured_accuracy: synthetic fractional Gaussian noise with known exponents recovered within about 0.10 to 0.15 (blocker: forecast/tests/test_hurst_estimator_20261030.py); rescaled range was built first and rejected on measured bias (white noise read 0.70 at a 250 return window)
estimator_frozen.wiring_state: not wired: the estimator exists and is frozen, so the decision rule's precondition is met; wiring the gate into engine_03 and engine_09 scores is a separate step that has not been taken, and no engine score changes because of this entry

research_questions.decision_rule: Wire as a conditioner only after a Hurst estimator is built and frozen in the registry; until then the gate is recorded, not applied, and no engine's score changes because of it.

research_questions.name: Sector diffusion damper (conditioner only)
research_questions.statement: FE06 is admitted only as a conditioner: its dispersion damper, 1 / (1 + 0.20 * clip(dispersion_z, 0, 3)), may damp family and rotation readings when cross-sector dispersion is high on the named engines. Its headline sector leadership score is not adopted, because the code read showed the damper is the load-bearing term and contemporaneous sector membership and rank normalisation are unspecified in the source package.

data_routes.name: sector membership and sector daily bars

research_questions.decision_rule: Wire as a conditioner only after contemporaneous sector membership and rank normalisation are specified and frozen; until then the damper is recorded, not applied.
research_questions.waiting_on: Sector membership completion in the terminal's own sector record (sector-rotation counts 335 of 1,833 scored names without a sector on record at 2026-10-30; that map is stream B work in the remainders program). Rank normalisation is specified with the membership, not before it: the damper consumes cross-sector dispersion of the same membership, so freezing a normalisation against a partial map would freeze the wrong population. State recorded 2026-10-30 by fix stream C; the damper stays recorded, not applied.

route_evidence.disposition: follows RC-12, closed with it as a stated limit on 2026-10-30: sector membership for 335 of 1,833 scored names exists on no in-bounds record (four routes scanned and evidenced in sector-rotation/sector_scan_20261030.json, limit published on the Sector Rotation page with all 335 names). The rank normalisation half is specified in this entry and applies to the 1,498 names with membership on record; the diffusion question can only be evaluated for those names until a membership source for the remaining 335 exists.

research_questions.name: Caller supplied macro reaction sign (input form for Engine 24)
research_questions.statement: FE27's reaction sign is adopted as a FORM only: Engine 24's cohort definitions may carry a caller supplied cycle_reaction_sign in [-1, 1] (read as a signed confidence in the reaction direction, not a binary sign) and a regime_confidence in [0, 1], both declared at issuance and frozen with the forecast. FE27 itself is not adopted: its horizon contradiction (30 minutes post release in its README against intraday to 5 sessions in its catalog) must be resolved by its author before the engine can be graded, and no Engine 24 cohort is required to carry the form until a macro cohort uses it.

data_routes.name: macro release calendar and surprise series (events family)
caller declaration at issuance, frozen in the ledger row

research_questions.decision_rule: The form is available to Engine 24 cohort definitions from this entry onward; adopting FE27 as an engine is a separate decision that stays closed until its author resolves the horizon contradiction.

form_fields.name: cycle_reaction_sign
form_fields.range: [-1, 1], caller supplied, clipped by the consumer, declared at issuance
